fixtures.pids:
require "json"; require "fiddle"; children=[]; denied=false
fork_call=Fiddle::Function.new(Fiddle.dlopen(nil)["fork"],[],Fiddle::TYPE_INT)
80.times do
pid=fork_call.call
if pid<0; denied=true; break; elsif pid==0; sleep 30; exit! 0; else; children << pid; end
end
children.each { |pid| Process.kill("KILL",pid) rescue nil }; children.each { |pid| Process.wait(pid) rescue nil }
puts JSON.generate(fork_allowed: !children.empty?, fork_denied: denied)
fixtures.privilege:
require "json"; require "fiddle"
lib=Fiddle.dlopen(nil)
mount=Fiddle::Function.new(lib["mount"],[Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP,Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP,Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP,Fiddle::TYPE_LONG,Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP],Fiddle::TYPE_INT)
ptrace=Fiddle::Function.new(lib["ptrace"],[Fiddle::TYPE_LONG,Fiddle::TYPE_LONG,Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP,Fiddle::TYPE_VOIDP],Fiddle::TYPE_LONG)
unshare=Fiddle::Function.new(lib["unshare"],[Fiddle::TYPE_INT],Fiddle::TYPE_INT)
